对话 1。
Conversation 1.
汤姆，你在网上看到关于根据这本书改编的新电视剧三体问题？
Tom, did you see the article online about the new TV series based on the book The Three-Body Problem?
一位同事提到了这本书，但我一直我忙着写论文，所以没有几个月来我一直能够愉快地读书。
A colleague mentioned the book, but I've been so busy writing my thesis that I haven't been able to read for pleasure in months.
好吧，听起来如果你要读任何有趣的东西，这就是这本书。
Well, sounds like if you're going to read anything for fun, this is the book.
它是由一位中国科幻小说作家写的。
It's written by a Chinese science fiction writer.
我不记得他的名字了。
I can't remember his name.
但他总共写了三本书，而且《三体》是第一部该系列。
But he's written three books in all, and The Three-Body Problem is the first in the series.
我不想说太多剧透了，但肯定有其中有一些令人惊叹的技术和社会学概念。
I don't want to say too much and spoil it for you, but it's definitely got some amazing technological and sociological concepts in it.
听起来确实适合我品味，但如果他们正在制作电视现在基于它的系列，我不知道我是否应该读书或看先看演出。
It does sound like it would suit my taste, but if they are making a TV series based on it now, I don't know if I should read the book or watch the show first.
我认为读书更好第一的。
I think it's better to read the book first.
很少有节目或电影比书本更好，然后你最终毁了这本书如果节目不是很好。
It's rare for the show or movie to be better than the book, and then you just end up ruining the book for yourself if the show isn't very good.
我有点不知所措我还需要收集数据才能完成我的论文，但我仍然需要放松有时。
I'm a bit overwhelmed with the amount of data I still need to collect to finish my thesis, but I still need to relax sometimes.
我记不太清楚了。
I can't remember exactly.
很快就要到了，而且很快就会相当长。
It's pretty soon, and it's going to be quite long.
共24集。
There are 24 episodes.
嗯，也许你可以下载一份电子版并尝试阅读这本书演出开始前。
Well, maybe you could download an electronic copy of the book and try to read it before the show starts.
这是个好主意，也许我们可以一起看这个系列。
That's a good idea, and then maybe we can watch the series together.
谢谢你的提示，爱丽丝。
Thanks for the tip, Alice.
没问题。
No problem.
对话2 你好，下午好。
Conversation 2 Hello, good afternoon.
我有一件事情要询问。
I have an inquiry to make.
这是关于你参加的素食节于 8 月 19 日在纽卡斯尔市政厅。
It's about the vegetarian food festival you are holding on the 19th of August at the Newcastle City Hall.
是的当然。
Yes, of course.
我叫菲利普。
My name's Philip.
您的网站上说您是仍在寻找供应商，我种植有机产品我农场里的蔬菜，以及我自己在家烘焙。
It says on your website that you are still looking for vendors, and I grow organic vegetables on my farm, as well as doing my own home baking.
我可以同时出售蔬菜和用它们烘焙的食品节日？
Would I be able to sell both the vegetables and items baked from them at the festival?
这正是我们寻找。
That's exactly the type of thing we are looking for.
然而，我们已经接近最后期限了。
We are getting close to the deadline, however.
您是否希望填写申请表在网上，或打印出来然后手工填写并将其寄回给我们？
Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
请记住，你必须拥有一切填写表格时要准备好的证书由于标准很高并且会在任何人之前仔细检查它们能够出售他们的产品该事件。
Remember that you will have to have all your certificates to hand when you are filling out the forms, as the standards are high and they will be carefully checked before anyone will be able to sell their produce at the event.
我应该可以我已经拥有了所有证书，因为我们经营一家小型农场商店也。
I should be fine with doing it on your website, and I already have all my certificates, as we run a small farm shop too.
但你能告诉我你的详细资料吗？
But can you give me your details anyway?
当然。
Sure.
请寄给有机组织、供应商申请地址：诺森伯兰郡纽卡斯尔皇后路 112 号。
Please address it to the Organic Organisation, Vendor Applications, 112 Queens Road, Newcastle, Northumbria.
邮政编码是 NU29 3LJ。
The postcode is NU29 3LJ.
请记住截止日期是下周二，六月二十八日。
Remember that the closing date is next Tuesday, the 28th of June.
这真是太棒了。
That's absolutely wonderful.
非常感谢您的帮助。
Thank you so much for your help.
再见！
Goodbye!
